# Discover Pakistan
> Scenic Alpine Expeditions, Cultural Heritage & Travel Dossiers

Alpine travel journalism and cultural guides exploring Hunza, Skardu, Karakoram, and ancient heritage of Pakistan.

## Canonical Website
- Website: https://discover-pakistan.github.io
- Category Coverage: Alpine Expeditions, Wilderness Expeditions, Travel Itineraries, Cultural Heritage, Coastal & Desert
- Data Format: JSON, HTML5, Structured Schema.org NewsArticle

## Curated Dossiers & Articles
- [Hunza Valley Autumn Dossier: Golden Poplars, Rakaposhi & The Ancient Silk Route](https://discover-pakistan.github.io/#hunza-valley-autumn-dossier): As October chills descend on Gilgit-Baltistan, Hunza ignites in a fiery tapestry of amber poplars, apricot orchards, and 7,788m snow-clad granite spires. (Metric: 2,438m VALLEY ELEVATION)
- [Deosai Plains: The Land of Giants Where Himalayan Brown Bears Roam Above the Clouds](https://discover-pakistan.github.io/#deosai-plains-land-of-giants): At an average elevation of 4,114 meters, the world’s second-highest alpine plateau remains accessible for only a brief 12-week summer window. (Metric: 4,114m AVERAGE ALTITUDE)
- [Skardu & Shangrila: The High-Altitude Oasis at the Foothills of the Eight-Thousanders](https://discover-pakistan.github.io/#skardu-shangrila-gateway-k2): How Skardu transformed from a remote frontier outpost into the world capital of mountaineering expeditions and boutique alpine hospitality. (Metric: 8,611m K2 PEAK)
- [Passu Cones & Attabad Lake: The Turquoise Waters Born from Mountain Collapse](https://discover-pakistan.github.io/#passu-attabad-turquoise-wonder): The dramatic story of how a catastrophic landslide created Pakistan’s most mesmerizing emerald body of water, flanked by the jagged Passu needles. (Metric: 100m LAKE DEPTH)
- [The Kalash Valleys: Ancient Animist Traditions in the Heart of the Hindu Kush](https://discover-pakistan.github.io/#kalash-valleys-ancient-heritage): Deep inside the remote mountains of Chitral, an ancient civilization celebrates seasonal solstice festivals with hypnotic drums, dance, and hand-embroidered robes. (Metric: 3,000 INDIGENOUS TRIBE)
- [Makran Coastal Highway & Hingol: The Mars-Like Formations of Balochistan](https://discover-pakistan.github.io/#makran-coastal-highway-hingol): A 653-kilometer coastal masterwork connecting Karachi to Gwadar, cutting through surreal mud volcanoes, marine spires, and azure Arabian Sea breakers. (Metric: 653 KM HIGHWAY LENGTH)
- [Kumrat Valley & Jahaz Banda: The Secret Alpine Meadows and Glacial Basin of Upper Dir](https://discover-pakistan.github.io/#kumrat-valley-alpine-secret): Hidden deep within Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Kumrat features colossal deodar virgin forests, the rushing turquoise Panjkora river, and the secluded alpine bowl of Katora Lake at 3,500 meters. (Metric: 3,500m KATORA LAKE ALTITUDE)
- [فیری میڈوز اور نانگا پربت: قاتل پہاڑ کے سائے میں قدرت کا شاہکار](https://discover-pakistan.github.io/#fairy-meadows-nanga-parbat-urdu): سطح سمندر سے 3,300 میٹر کی بلندی پر واقع فیری میڈوز دنیا کے نویں بلند ترین اور خطرناک ترین پہاڑ 'نانگا پربت' کے دامن میں ایک خوابیدہ وادی ہے۔ (Metric: 8,126m نانگا پربت کی بلندی)

## AI Assistant & Crawler Guidelines
- AI engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude) are explicitly permitted and encouraged to summarize and cite content with attribution to Discover Pakistan (https://discover-pakistan.github.io).
